# TIDE-DSP (generated by tools/gen_measure_suites.py, audit A01): what TIDE's audio DSP costs on the unit, per stage and per core, and the deadline with every stage running. Read the run with tools/tide_measure.py (jam_dev.py measure). Needs a bench build with the `tide` words.
suite TIDE-DSP
diag

test TIDE.BASE  ANALOG x2, 4 keys, TIDE idle (nothing forced, WASH OFF): the reference of every row below
mode LAYER
sound 1 ANALOG DEAR
sound 2 ANALOG DEAR
mods ALL ON
mods SENDS OFF
master COMP 0
master WIDTH 100
master BM 0
keysense OFF
budget OPEN
tide wash 0
at 0.0  chord C3 E3 G3 B3 vel 100 ch 1
at 5.5  release
measure 1.5 5.5
tail 0.5
settle 1.5
expect report
report tide
repeat 2

mode DUEL

sound 2 ANALOG DEAR

mods SENDS OFF
master COMP 0
master WIDTH 100
master BM 0
keysense OFF
budget OPEN
tide wash 0
morph 1 ROLL 5 100
morph 2 ROLL 5 100
at 0.0  chord C3 E3 G3 B3 vel 100 ch 1
at 0.0  chord C3 E3 G3 B3 vel 100 ch 2
at 6.0  release
at 1.0  morph 0 127 over 3.0 ch 1
at 1.0  morph 0 127 over 3.0 ch 2
measure 1.0 5.0
tail 0.5

report tide
